'''Grabthar's Hammer''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] dropped by [[Grabthar the Overbearing]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Forum Highlands]].

==Stats==
:[[Earth damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Twin Hammer]] dyed black.
